request: The soil science meeting in Denver ends on Thursday, December 10, but I'm staying on in Denver for a few personal days. Please book my flight home to Houston on Sunday, December 13.

trip.destination_place: Houston, Texas (on the way home to Baton Rouge)
trip.purpose: Return from a soil science society meeting, after personal days in Denver
notes: The meeting runs December 7-10; the traveller stays in Denver at his own expense until December 13.

must_keep.quote: Whenever airfare does not include a personal destination, the traveler adds personal days to the business destination, the total amount of airfare is reimbursable.
must_keep.why: personal days at the business destination leave the whole fare reimbursable

must_keep.quote: Commercial air travel will not be reimbursed more than lowest logical coach/economy class rates when it has been determined to be the best value. The difference between coach/economy class rates and first class or business class rates will be paid by the traveler.
must_keep.why: the University pays the lowest logical coach fare; the traveller pays any difference

must_keep.quote: The lowest logical airfare is the cheapest available at the time of booking without causing undo inconvenience. These types of airfares are non-refundable, penalty tickets.
must_keep.why: definition P: the lowest logical airfare, non-refundable

design_notes: No personal destination is on the ticket: the traveller adds personal days at the business destination, so the whole airfare is reimbursable (lines 468-470). Book the lowest logical fare home. The prorating rule (lines 462-467) is for a ticket that includes a personal destination.
